# BCGov Crow - v0.17.1

## Release type

Patch release: shared interaction contracts, completion gates, and agent
handoffs for existing agents and skills.

## Summary

Added a canonical interaction-contracts module to `crow-agent-skill-authoring`
and applied it across existing agents. Every agent now ends with a Completion
gate and a standard completion report. Legacy modernization gains a validated,
signed-off data-change handoff to `crow-data-architecture`.

## Highlights

- One interaction-contracts module defines evidence before writes, approval
  and write permission, the completion report (`complete`, `partial`,
  `blocked`, or `failed`), open items, handoff files, live-provider contracts,
  resumable sessions, preserving existing content, supplied documents, and
  re-checking assumptions. Agents link to it with short wording instead of
  repeating it.
- The asset validator now fails when an agent has no Completion gate section
  that links to the standard completion report. It also validates VS Code
  `handoffs` frontmatter: each entry needs a label, a known agent name, and a
  prompt, must set `send: false`, and must not set a model. Unsupported YAML
  forms are reported instead of skipped.
- Agents that naturally lead to another Crow agent now offer VS Code
  handoffs, for example security review to remediation or the executive
  report, and implementation agents to code review.
- Legacy modernization records a datastore change request in
  `docs/modernization/data-change-handoff.json`, checked by
  `Test-DataChangeHandoff.ps1` for structure, existing evidence and artifacts,
  a current source revision, and data-owner sign-off with a recorded approval
  before `crow-data-architecture` acts on it. The handoff stays current while
  the repository descends from its source revision without changes to the
  files it references, so committing it or unrelated work does not make it
  stale.
- The analytics design handoff now records schema version, generation time,
  and source revision.
- To stay within the agent context limit, the security review agent's
  capability-limit and detection-module wording was shortened without changing
  its rules.

## Scope and verification

No new agents or skills were created. Collections now include every handoff
target of their agents, and the asset validator fails when one is missing: the
Security Remediation collection adds the Executive Summary Report agent and
`crow-executive-report` skill, and the Starter Package adds the Security &
Dependency Review, Security Remediation, and Executive Summary Report agents
with the `crow-executive-report` skill. Full-package, plugin, and
collection manifests are aligned at 0.17.1. Asset, package, and release checks
are required before publication; final release verification and checksums
remain pending.
